title: 真实HTTPS上传发布隔离：不可信文件名、PNG/ZIP边界、扫描摘要绑定和独立发布授权
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 给出题设要求的具体交付物与关键机制

明确停止条件及回退或恢复边界
body:
## 操作任务
实现upload/approve/publish/published/revoke及其内部帮助函数。服务自有store含uploads/meta/published；对象ID为服务端随机32位小写hex，原文件名仅写JSON元数据，绝不作路径或响应头。上传仅接受≤65536字节真实PNG（Pillow校验且≤1024像素）或ZIP（1..8项、拒绝绝对/../反斜线穿越/盘符/链接/重名，实际读取累计解压≤8192字节）；其他内容ValueError。初始pending不可公开。approve要求scanner_authorized严格True，verdict不为True保持pending并清批准；批准摘要必须匹配当前通过格式校验的实际字节。publish要求publisher_authorized严格True且approved状态，重读普通对象核对批准SHA256，变化必须重新审查；用同一读出快照原子写独立published副本后发布，不能硬链接原上传文件。published只对published状态返回独立副本并验证摘要；revoke只允许发布者并关闭新下载。root为可信私有目录，ID严格校验，元数据原子替换。真实HTTPS接口由夹具认证角色、串行执行操作，并强制下载为attachment/octet-stream/nosniff；不得相信请求体authorized。撤销不能收回已下载字节。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Python HTTPS接口、Pillow PNG解码验证、zipfile受限解压读取、文件系统隔离目录/摘要/原子替换和独立发布副本。角色是私有服务的测试凭据，不是宿主账号；扫描结论是受控可信夹具，不宣称实现商业杀毒、多引擎扫描、OS DAC/MAC隔离或分布式并发发布。夹具通过串行服务检查扫描后、发布前的实际对象替换，未冒充任意底层并发链接竞态防护。临时CA仅子客户端使用，不改宿主信任/身份或正式服务，不构建镜像，不新增原故障完成量。

"""Private verified TLS fixtures; ephemeral CA files never enter host trust or default credentials."""
import contextlib,datetime,ipaddress,json,pathlib,ssl,threading,urllib.request,urllib.error
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
def certificate(root):
 root=pathlib.Path(root);root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);key=rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048)
 name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,'OpsForge ephemeral private TLS fixture')])
 cert=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(name).issuer_name(name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(now-datetime.timedelta(minutes=5)).not_valid_after(now+datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).add_extension(x509.BasicConstraints(ca=True,path_length=None),critical=True).add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.IPAddress(ipaddress.ip_address('127.0.0.1'))]),critical=False).sign(key,hashes.SHA256())
 pem=root/'ca.pem';private=root/'key.pem';pem.write_bytes(cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM));private.write_bytes(key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption()))
 context=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER);context.load_cert_chain(str(pem),str(private));return pem,context
@contextlib.contextmanager
def server(root,handler):
 pem,context=certificate(root);http=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),handler);http.daemon_threads=True;http.socket=context.wrap_socket(http.socket,server_side=True)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=http.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start()
 try:yield 'https://127.0.0.1:'+str(http.server_port),pem
 finally:http.shutdown();http.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
def client(cafile,jar=None):
 context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cafile));handlers=[urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=context)]
 if jar is not None:handlers.append(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))
 opener=urllib.request.build_opener(*handlers)
 def call(method,url,payload=None,headers=None):
  req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else (b'' if method=='POST' else None),method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json',**(headers or {})})
  try:
   with opener.open(req,timeout=4) as r:status,raw,response_headers=r.status,r.read().decode(),dict(r.headers)
  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status,raw,response_headers=e.code,e.read().decode(),dict(e.headers)
  try:body=json.loads(raw)
  except ValueError:body=raw
  return status,body,response_headers
 return call

import base64,hashlib,io,json,pathlib,secrets,sys,tempfile,threading,zipfile
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from private_tls_http import server,client
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
def png(color):
 out=io.BytesIO();Image.new("RGB",(1,1),color).save(out,format="PNG");return out.getvalue()
def zipped(name,data):
 out=io.BytesIO()
 with zipfile.ZipFile(out,"w",compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:z.writestr(name,data)
 return out.getvalue()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-upload-review-") as temp:
 root=pathlib.Path(temp);store=root/"store";sentinel=root/"server.conf";sentinel.write_bytes(b"approved private service configuration")
 scanner=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);publisher=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);uploader=secrets.token_urlsafe(32);lock=threading.RLock()
 class App(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
  def response(self,status,body,headers=None):
   raw=body if isinstance(body,bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode();self.send_response(status)
   for key,value in (headers or {"Content-Type":"application/json"}).items():self.send_header(key,value)
   self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(raw)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(raw)
  def do_GET(self):
   ident=self.path.removeprefix("/public/")
   try:
    with lock:data=task.published(store,ident)
    self.response(200,data,{"Content-Type":"application/octet-stream","Content-Disposition":"attachment; filename="+ident+".bin","X-Content-Type-Options":"nosniff"})
   except (FileNotFoundError,ValueError):self.response(404,{})
  def do_POST(self):
   data=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])));role=self.headers.get("Authorization","")
   try:
    with lock:
     if self.path=="/upload":result=task.upload(store,data["name"],base64.b64decode(data["content"]),data["declared"])
     elif self.path=="/approve":result=task.approve(store,data["id"],data["digest"],data.get("verdict"),role=="Bearer "+scanner)
     elif self.path=="/publish":result=task.publish(store,data["id"],role=="Bearer "+publisher)
     elif self.path=="/revoke":result=task.revoke(store,data["id"],role=="Bearer "+publisher)
     else:return self.response(404,{})
    self.response(200,{"result":result})
   except PermissionError:self.response(403,{})
   except (ValueError,FileNotFoundError):self.response(400,{})
 with server(root/"tls",App) as (base,ca):
  call=client(ca)
  def post(path,data,token=uploader):return call("POST",base+path,data,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
  red,blue=png("red"),png("blue")
  print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: actual HTTPS upload review digest binding and independent publication",flush=True)
  status,data,_=post("/upload",dict(name="../../server.conf",declared="image/png",content=base64.b64encode(red).decode()));assert status==200
  ident=data["result"];assert len(ident)==32 and ident not in ["server.conf","../../server.conf"]
  assert sentinel.read_bytes()==b"approved private service configuration" and (store/"uploads"/ident).read_bytes()==red
  status,data,_=post("/upload",dict(name="../../server.conf",declared="image/png",content=base64.b64encode(blue).decode()));assert status==200 and data["result"]!=ident
  assert call("GET",base+"/public/"+ident)[0]==404
  for declared,content in [("image/png",b"<html><script>fixture</script></html>"),("application/zip",zipped("../escape",b"x")),("application/zip",zipped("oversize",b"a"*9000))]:
   assert post("/upload",dict(name="misleading.png",declared=declared,content=base64.b64encode(content).decode()))[0]==400
  digest=hashlib.sha256(red).hexdigest()
  assert post("/approve",dict(id=ident,digest=digest,verdict=True),uploader)[0]==403
  assert post("/approve",dict(id=ident,digest=digest,verdict=None),scanner)[:2]==(200,{"result":False})
  assert post("/publish",dict(id=ident),publisher)[0]==400 and call("GET",base+"/public/"+ident)[0]==404
  assert post("/approve",dict(id=ident,digest=digest,verdict=True),scanner)[0]==200
  (store/"uploads"/ident).write_bytes(blue)
  assert post("/publish",dict(id=ident),publisher)[0]==400,"scan approval cannot authorize later bytes"
  assert call("GET",base+"/public/"+ident)[0]==404
  print("NATIVE_UPLOAD_OPAQUE_IDS_FILENAME_TRAVERSAL_MIME_SPOOF_ARCHIVE_TRAVERSAL_SIZE_AND_UNAVAILABLE_SCAN_FAIL_CLOSED",flush=True)
  assert post("/approve",dict(id=ident,digest=hashlib.sha256(blue).hexdigest(),verdict=True),scanner)[0]==200
  assert post("/publish",dict(id=ident,authorized=True),uploader)[0]==403,"client boolean cannot grant publisher authority"
  assert post("/publish",dict(id=ident),publisher)[0]==200
  # Retrieve binary data without passing it through the JSON/text client.
  import ssl,urllib.request
  raw_client=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(ca))))
  with raw_client.open(base+"/public/"+ident,timeout=4) as r:
   saved=r.read();assert saved==blue and r.headers["Content-Type"]=="application/octet-stream" and r.headers["Content-Disposition"].startswith("attachment;") and r.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"]=="nosniff"
  (store/"uploads"/ident).write_bytes(red)
  with raw_client.open(base+"/public/"+ident,timeout=4) as r:assert r.read()==saved
  assert post("/revoke",dict(id=ident),uploader)[0]==403
  assert post("/revoke",dict(id=ident),publisher)[0]==200 and call("GET",base+"/public/"+ident)[0]==404
  assert saved==blue and sentinel.read_bytes()==b"approved private service configuration"
  print("NATIVE_UPLOAD_CHANGED_BYTES_REQUIRE_REVIEW_ONLY_PUBLISHER_CAN_RELEASE_ATTACHMENT_COPY_INDEPENDENT_REVOKE_BLOCKS_NEW_DOWNLOADS",flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
